title: Factory tables of the 17 appended framework AIDL interfaces (CodeLinaro LA.UM.8.12.c3-64900, PICO and Smartisan)

signature_check.note: compare-aidl-tables compares method names and codes only. A full signature/direction/oneway check of every common framework, services and telephony-common table found IBatteryStats.notePhoneDataConnectionState(IZI), ported from CodeLinaro; the remaining differences below are in tables outside this chunk.

donors.IBatteryStats.notePhoneDataConnectionSta: CodeLinaro frameworks/base (signature difference inside the IBatteryStats table)
donors.IPlayer.setExtVolume: PICO, factory DEX and factory libaudioclient/libaaudio disassembly
donors.IActivityManager.getMonitorEx/getISmtEx/: Smartisan, factory DEX (minimal subset with the factory bridge defaults)

explained_differences.Landroid/app/ActivityThread$H;: handleMessage default branch: the factory forwards unknown messages to ActivityThreadSmtBase.handleMessage (Smartisan 1011 COMPLETE_PREFETCH_BIND_APPLICATION / 3000 handlers) - Smartisan chunk.
explained_differences.Landroid/app/ActivityThread;: <init>: factory ExtImplFactory.getImpl reflection vs the Source convention new ExtActivityThreadImpl(this), plus unported ActivityThreadMonitorEx. handleBindApplication: unported Smartisan/QTI hooks (ApplicationInfoSmtBase flags, density override, sys_hook, HeavyGame, AnrLogger, BinderCallsStats, prefetch bind, BoostFramework).
explained_differences.Landroid/app/ActivityThreadSmtBase;: <init>: only the reached fields (mPrefetchData, mActivityThread) are ported; mPrefetchAppContext/mFreezePrefetch/startTime belong to the Smartisan prefetch path.
explained_differences.Landroid/app/AppOpsManager;: <clinit>: pre-existing CodeLinaro ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION op and the ByteDance bindCallCacheCheckPackage property of the factory; unrelated to these tables (listed through D8 renumbering).
explained_differences.Landroid/content/pm/ApplicationInfo;: Constructors/Parcel: the factory also has unported overrideRes/overrideDensity and ApplicationInfoMonitorEx; appInfoJsonConfig/appLastTime (needed by IPackageManagerSmtEx.updateAppInfo) are at the factory parcel position with factory WHITELIST flags; Ext construction by direct new (Source convention).
explained_differences.Landroid/hardware/input/InputManager;: <init>: ExtImplFactory reflection vs direct new ExtInputManagerImpl (Source convention).
explained_differences.Landroid/telephony/CarrierConfigManager;: <clinit>: other CodeLinaro carrier-config keys (RTT, bandwidth table, 5G icon string, opportunistic data switch) of unrelated features; the 5G unmetered/hysteresis/watchdog keys used by onSubscriptionPlansChanged are identical.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/internal/os/BatteryStatsImp: Constructors and parcel readers: Source r47 keeps mIsCellularTxPowerHigh which the factory lacks; notePhoneDataConnectionStateLocked(dataType, hasData, serviceType) is identical to CodeLinaro/factory.

explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/ISysSvsFactory$3;: Anonymous default-class numbering: only reached getters are ported, so ISysSvsFactory defaults are $1..$10 instead of the factory $6,$10,$19,$23,$33,$34,$42,$49,$53,$54 (factory $3 is PowerAdvisorInternal).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/SysOptBridge;: <clinit>: the unreached SYSOPT_MULTIPLAT_CLASS_NAME/getMultiPlatFactory are not ported; getFactory is identical.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/-$$Lambda$UV1wDVo: D8 lambda class hash differs from the factory -$$Lambda$gfCssnBJI7TKfXb_Jmv7raVYNkY (same lambda of getPrefetchPids).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/ActivityManagerSe: Constructors: unported PICO IExtActivityManagerService and Smartisan setActivityManagerService/IActivityManagerOptEx/initSmartisanOS/ATMS SmtEx setAMS. addErrorToDropBox: only the factory customErrorType "Type:" line is ported; the other factory extras (DropBox logs, write-rate limit, IsSilentAnr, is_screen_on, AnrMonitor supplement) belong to the Smartisan chunk.
Constructors reduced to reached fields (mActivityManagerService, mStrictModeFlags, mTransferService, mIActivityManagerSmtEx, mPrefetchApps); getPrefetchPids differs only in the D8 lambda class name.
Constructors: mPendingLaunchRecords and mSmtOptEx (SysMonitorSvcBridge getActivityManager) are not reached by the 5 AIDL methods, which are identical.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/ProcExtraInfoSmtB: Synthetic accessor numbering: only the reached accessors exist, so access$N point to other fields (getLastWordOfPid is identical after normalisation).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/ProcessRecordSmtB: <init>: only smtExtraInfo/delayFreezing are ported; the other ~40 Smartisan process fields belong to the Smartisan chunk.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/am/UidRecordSmtBase;: <init>: only curFrozenStat is ported; freezingMode/setSchedGroup/setFrozenStat belong to the Smartisan freezer.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/backup/ExtUserBackup: getWakelock(): the factory has the Android 11 security backport UserBackupManagerService$BackupWakeLock; Source keeps PowerManager.WakeLock (same acquire/release calls).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/backup/Trampoline;: <init>: ExtImplFactory reflection vs direct new ExtTrampolineImpl (Source convention).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/backup/UserBackupMan: <init>: Ext construction convention and the BackupWakeLock backport; tearDownAgentAndKill: factory MORE_DEBUG=true logging (Source keeps the if (MORE_DEBUG) guard).
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/backup/fullbackup/Fu: run(): factory MORE_DEBUG logging, and the factory forwards include/exclude paths to the in-place changed IBackupAgent.doFullBackup (7 arguments) - separate IBackupAgent change, not ported.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/backup/fullbackup/Pi: handleCancel: factory field of the BackupWakeLock/Android 11 backport; run(): BackupWakeLock backport.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/backup/restore/FullR: <init>: Ext construction convention; restoreOneFile: factory MORE_DEBUG logging.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/backup/restore/PicoF: run(): BackupWakeLock backport and factory MORE_DEBUG logging.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/notification/Notific: dump(): pre-existing Source r47 vs factory difference (small-icon dump), unrelated; listed because of D8 renumbering.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/pm/PackageManagerSer: <init>: unported PICO IExtPackageManagerService and Smartisan SmartisanOSInit/PeroptWhiteListParser; getISmtEx and getSplitPermissions are identical.
Extends Object instead of IPackageManagerMonitorEx$Stub (IPackageManagerMonitorEx is not returned by any appended method; Smartisan chunk).
<init>: javac/D8 null-check form for the inner Stub instantiation.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/pm/permission/Permis: restorePermissionState: unported PICO IExtPermissionManagerService.allowAlertWindowAndRevokeInstallPermission hook; the split-permission loop is identical to CodeLinaro.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/power/ExtPowerManage: The factory $1 is an LED receiver; the ported DeathRecipient is $1 in Source (unported LED classes shift numbering).

<init>/systemReady: LED/DP (ro.pxr.dpstream.support) state and receivers not ported; systemReady resets pvr.factorytest.never.sleep as the factory but returns false so the Source battery receiver stays registered (the factory returns true because its PICO LED receivers replace it).

explained_differences.Lcom/android/server/usb/UsbDeviceManager: <init>: Ext construction convention; startAccessoryMode(): the factory delegates to the PICO startAccessoryMode(boolean) (settings-caller/pre-accessory feature, not ported); Source keeps the AOSP body.

Same: EVENT_RETRY_CONNECTION/EVENT_NR_* handling of other CodeLinaro features.
<clinit>/dump/getNetworkCapabilities: CodeLinaro EVENT_NR_*/handover/disallowed-APN and link-bandwidth features not ported; the unmetered override is identical.
onReceive: accessor vs direct calls caused by unported CodeLinaro DcTracker members.
Accessor vs direct field access (factory fields are package-private through unported CodeLinaro features); logic identical.
Constructors/handleMessage: other CodeLinaro DcTracker features (essential SIM records, bandwidths, IA APN, handover fallback) not ported.
explained_differences.Lcom/android/internal/telephony/imsphone: processCode: other CodeLinaro MMI changes (CS fallback, CF SIA/SIB handling) not ported; the serviceClass interrogate path is identical.

faithful_factory_failures: Session.getISmtEx casts SessionSmtBase to IWindowSessionSmtEx and throws ClassCastException, as in the factory

BatteryStatsService.getIBatteryStatsOptEx throws ClassCastException while the sys-services JAR is absent (the default BatteryStatsServiceOptEx does not implement IBatteryStatsOptEx), as in the factory
PackageManagerServiceMonitorEx.isTaskPersist dereferences the never-written mPermissionManager, as in the factory
FeatLog.e/SmtSysLog.fatal write log buffer 9 (sysfatal), rejected by stock liblog; getLastword therefore throws while the last-word map is empty
completePrefetchBindApplication dereferences mPrefetchData before its null check, as in the factory
left_for_other_chunks: PICO ExtAudioServiceImpl background muting (server caller of IPlayer.setExtVolume)
IBackupAgent.doFullBackup include/exclude paths (factory changes that signature in place) and ExtBackupAgentImpl
CodeLinaro DcTracker bandwidth/NR features, CameraService secure-camera and aux-camera filtering
